question: What is the name of the joint military exercise between India and Oman, that was conducted in September 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Exercise Al Najah**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The joint military exercise between India and Oman is named Exercise Al Najah.**
 
• **The 5th edition of Exercise Al Najah was held from 13th to 26th September 2024 at the Rabkoot Training Area in Salalah, Oman.**
 
• This biennial exercise focuses on enhancing joint military capabilities, specifically counter-terrorism operations in desert environments.
 
• Both the Indian Army and the Royal Army of Oman are participating with 60 personnel each in this joint exercise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Desert Operations:** The exercise focuses on tactical drills in a desert environment, including counter-drone operations and room intervention.
 
• **Counter-Terrorism Focus:** The primary objective is to rehearse joint planning and counter-terrorism operations under Chapter VII of the United Nations Charter.
 
• **Interoperability and Cooperation:** This exercise fosters interoperability and cooperation between the two armies, strengthening their defense ties.
 
• **Past Editions:** The last edition of Exercise Al Najah was conducted at Mahajan, Rajasthan in 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• OMAN:

 
 
• The Sultanate of Oman is a country in Arabia.
 
• It is located on the southeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula, and overlooks the mouth of the Persian Gulf.
 
• It shares land borders with Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Yemen.
 
• The capital and largest city is Muscat. 
 
• Currency: Omani Rial.
 
• Official language: Arabic.
